title_how: How it works: a second payer on sites we already own

flow.detail: Score all ~44k sites for spare ground, structure load, grid power and fiber; publish a site catalog
10-15 year MLAs per industry with annual escalators, standard site fees and pre-approved designs
Payer funds and owns its radios, gateways or batteries; we handle permits, access and site build
Same 24/7 site ops, monitoring and billing as tower leases; add sites and amendments over the term

payers.pays_for: Antenna space for private LTE, smart-meter backhaul and grid sensors
Ground space and grid-adjacent land for small distribution-level BESS
Coverage sites for agribusiness, mining, ports and public safety networks
Secure, fiber-fed ground space and power for gateway antennas
